name: skills
one_liner: A free library of 'instruction packets' that teach an AI assistant like Claude how to do a specific job well, such as following a company's brand guide or a particular business workflow.
buyer: A consultant or agency that wants to package their own expertise (e.g. a specific accounting process or legal workflow) as a reusable AI skill they can sell or deploy for clients.
business_use_cases: An accounting firm packages its month-end close checklist as a custom skill and sells it as an add-on to clients using Claude for bookkeeping.
A consultant studies the official skills here as templates, then builds and sells a niche skill (e.g. 'insurance claims triage') to small agencies.
An AI-tools agency offers a 'skill audit' service, reviewing a client's internal docs and turning the best ones into working Claude skills.

money_ideas.idea: Sell custom, industry-specific skills built on this pattern directly to businesses
Paid consulting retainer to build and maintain a company's internal skill library

steal_this: Pick one repetitive task from your own job, turn it into a skill using this repo as a template, and offer to build the same for three local businesses this week.
